1. What subjects do you look forward to in school?
💡If you love Maths → Science/Commerce. If you love essays/debates → Arts.
2. What do you do in your free time voluntarily?
💡Gaming → Game Dev/CS. Reading news → Journalism/UPSC. Cooking → Culinary Arts.
3. Which type of problems excite you to solve?
💡Technical problems → Engineering. Human problems → Psychology/Law. Money problems → Commerce.
4. Who inspires you most — and what do they do?
💡Your role model's career often hints at your passion zone.
5. What would you do for FREE if money wasn't needed?
💡That's your passion. Now find a career that pays you for it.
Loves solving puzzles, analytical, patient, numbers excite you
Loves helping people, patient, emotionally intelligent, biology interest
Entrepreneurial spirit, loves markets, negotiations, money management
Artistic, loves design, writing, storytelling, questioning society
Loves building things, impatient with theory, practical learner
Always online, loves apps, games, coding, creating content, tech trends
→ Computer Science / Digital Marketing / AI / UX

🔄What If You Choose the Wrong Stream?
IT'S OKAY. You are 16. Life gives you many chances. Here's what you can do 👇

In most CBSE/ICSE schools, you can switch 
stream within first few weeks of Class 11 
itself. Act quickly.

NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) 
lets you change subjects, retake boards, and 
switch streams at any age.

Arts student can do engineering if they clear 
bridge courses. Commerce student can do 
MA Economics. Options exist!

No matter your stream — learning coding, AI, design, or digital 
marketing can open entirely new career doors.

Jack Ma failed college 3x. Oprah was fired. Steve Jobs dropped out. 
YOUR story isn't over — it's just beginning!

IIT Kharagpur → Stanford → CEO of Google. PCM can take you to the 
top of the world!

Commerce + MBA → Built Reliance & Infosys. Net worth: Billions. 
Proof: Business beats all.

Kiran Bedi: Arts → First Female IPS officer. PeeCee: Arts → Global 
star. Arts = Unlimited ceiling!

S
Self-Assessment:  
Write down 3 subjects you genuinely enjoy + 3 things you do in free time. Look for patterns.

M
Market Research:  
Research 5 careers in each stream. Check salary, growth, job availability in India in 2030.

A
Ask Experts:  
Talk to 2 people working in your dream field. Visit shiksha.com for free counseling & college data.

R
Reality Check:  
Can you score well in this stream? Do you have the aptitude? Be honest, not just hopeful.

T
Take Action:  
Fill your stream form with confidence. Make a 100-day study plan. Start building skills from Day 1.
